method: Decode final FLOAT POSITION accessors, restore Blender axes (x,-glbZ,glbY), weld only exact identical positions within the same material primitive (paired blades intentionally share a base but use different materials) and traverse triangle-edge connected components. Leaf8-vertex components: longest pair gives base-tip/max chord; widest equal-axis pair gives blade width, shortest distinct pair gives peak thickness. Distances accumulated using Python double precision, not metadata parameter labels.

numerical_precision.coordinate_storage: IEEE754 float32 from final GLB accessors
numerical_precision.note: No relaxation of original0.15–0.23m limits. Disclosed endpoint error is tens of nanometers due float32 coordinate quantization, unlike original8.4mm normalization error. Fresh independent reviewer decides acceptance.
